name: CUAJO
description: Cuajo is a rummy card game of the rummy family played in the Philippines, involving melding, sets, and runs; uses a 112-card Spanish-suited deck.

content.text: Cuajo is a rummy card game of the rummy family played in the Philippines, involving melding, sets, and runs; uses a 112-card Spanish-suited deck.

Country/Region of Origin: Philippines
Time Period: Early 1900s
Historical Development: Rummy-family game played in the Philippines with Spanish-suited deck; shows signs of Asian origin, possibly adapted from Chinese chess-card games (e.g. Kua Oh).
Cultural Significance: Popular social and family game in the Philippines.
